required_runtime_state: C1 with 60 Hz outer update; waterfall constant block only; apply before entering the Pokitaru scene
rationale: Level01Waterfall callback runs once per outer update (TESTED, true stops). Its per-call fixed steps -1/60 on obj+0x70 and -0.025 on the second channel are read from the waterfall-only constant block 0x2D4880..0x2D489C at sites 0x151E78 / 0x151EA8. C1 doubles the outer frequency, so every real-time period driven by these steps halves (measured cycle halves). This edit halves the two constants so the C1 real-time periods match A0. One field edit cannot claim whole-object parity: the integer +0x79 step and the pvar+0x08 parity gate stay untouched until measured.
